messages:
liz_marketing: Quick heads-up — morning alert showed lead-claim SLA slipping to ~22m median for EMEA leads, up from our 5m target. :eyes:
sam_sales_ops: Ugh. Any pattern? timezones, enrichment lag, or RR queue backlog?
liz_marketing: Mostly leads hitting the enrichment step — HubSpot enrichment TTL appears to be stalling for ~30% of inbound. SF handoff shows delayed assignment too.
nana_revops: @liz_marketing can you paste an example lead id? I want to trace the enrichment webhook timing.
liz_marketing: sure — lead: 00D-39482; posted the webhook trace below.
liz_marketing: ```
POST /enrichments 200 OK 2023-09-14T09:12:03Z
GET /enrichment/00D-39482 202 Accepted 2023-09:12:04Z
GET /enrichment/00D-39482 504 Gateway Timeout 2023-09-14T09:14:10Z
```
devon_eng: Looks like transient enrichment timeouts are cascading into the RR claim loop. When enrichment fails we currently hold the claim and retry 3x with exponential backoff — that can blow past SLA.
sam_sales_ops: Current handoff flow: HS -> enrichment -> RR claim -> SF update. If enrichment stalls, leads wait instead of falling back to a lightweight assign. Can we add a short-circuit?
nana_revops: Agreed. Suggestion: if enrichment doesn't return within 8s, proceed with a minimal enrich snapshot (email, company) and assign, then fill rest async. Keeps SLA tight.
kevin_support: +1. Also need clearer observability — our dashboard shows backlog count but not per-step latency distribution. Hard to triage quickly.
devon_eng: I can add metric tags for step=enqueue|enrich|claim|sf-sync and a histogram for latency buckets. Should surface on the routing dashboard.
liz_marketing: That would help triage during spikes. Also want a policy change: for leads with lead_score < 20, use low-touch path (skip enrichment) to cut time. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sam_sales_ops: Low-touch path is fine, but watch for false negatives — maybe use a 24h re-enrich job to catch missed signals.
nana_revops: We should also tighten the RR worker concurrency cap per-region; right now global workers are absorbing EMEA and NA at once which adds queueing. Split pools by region.
devon_eng: Plan sketch: (1) fallback assign after 8s, (2) add latency tags + dashboard, (3) region-specific RR pools, (4) async re-enrich job. I can prototype the fallback and metrics tomorrow.
liz_marketing: Great. Can someone draft the handoff SLA update and playbook for on-call? Need an entry that says "if median claim > 7m, page revops and eng on-call".
kevin_support: I'll draft the playbook snippet and include runbook commands, e.g., `kubectl logs -l app=rr-worker -n routing --since=30m` and a KQL to find enrichment 504 spikes.
sam_sales_ops: @devon_eng once prototype is up, can we run a staged experiment: 5% of inbound -> fallback path, compare median claims?
devon_eng: Yup. We'll add a feature flag and monitor.
liz_marketing: Awesome. Can we target a ship window for the fallback + dashboard by EOD Wed? If not, update timeline.
devon_eng: EOD Wed for initial roll (feature flag + metrics). Region pool and re-enrich job next week.
nana_revops: I'll update the HubSpot mapping doc to reflect low-touch rules and notify the CS/Sales ops channel.
kevin_support: Adding on-call alert: `alert: LeadClaimMedianHigh` threshold 420s -> pages revops + eng. Drafting now.
sam_sales_ops: Thanks team. Please ping #marketing when the initial experiment goes live so ops can watch conversion impact.
hs_sync_bot: HubSpot sync job completed: 12 items retried, 3 failures — see https://internal.hubspot/log/1912345678
liz_marketing: Thanks @hs_sync_bot — will coordinate a short postmortem if failures persist. :thumbsup:
